items.titleZh: 国际汽联叫停F1轮辋研发竞赛
items.summaryZh: 国际汽联已采取行动，阻止F1出现一场围绕轮辋设计的新研发竞赛，避免只用于排位的轮辋成为必备装备。2026年规则允许车队自行设计轮辋后，各队发现优化轮胎温度可带来收益，法拉利在巴塞罗那大奖赛引入新轮辋帮助后轮冷却，并助力汉密尔顿夺冠。
items.originalTitle: Why an F1 arms race has been stopped before it could start
items.summaryEn: The FIA has moved to stop a potential new development arms race in Formula 1 over wheel rim designs, preventing qualifying-only rims from becoming a must-have item. After the 2026 rules allowed teams to design their own rims again, teams found gains in optimising tyre temperatures, with Ferrari introducing new rims at the Barcelona Grand Prix to improve rear cooling and help Lewis Hamilton take victory.
detailZh: 国际汽联已采取行动，阻止F1出现一场潜在的新研发竞赛，这场竞赛可能导致只用于排位的轮辋成为必备装备。
2026年F1规则的关键变化之一是放弃标准轮辋，车队再次获得使用自行设计轮辋的自由。
这引发了一场引人关注的升级竞争，因为各车队逐渐意识到优化轮胎温度可以带来收益。
例如在巴塞罗那大奖赛上，法拉利引入了新轮辋以帮助改善后轮冷却，这些轮辋在刘易斯·汉密尔顿为该队夺冠的过程中发挥了作用。
其他车队也效仿法拉利，在全年中调整了轮辋设计——尤其是迈凯伦，它一直试图通过新的轮辋设计来帮助更好地预热前轮胎、并更多地冷却后轮胎。
F1轮胎供应商倍耐力表示，年初就已明显看出，车队自己的设计在控制轮胎温度方面产生了多大影响。
其首席工程师西蒙·贝拉解释道：“这是一个相当显著的变化。
“我们今年看到的是，总体稳定后的条件比过去低得多，这是因为轮辋基本上在冷却整个车轮以及轮胎本身。”
各车队在今年过程中取得的进展表明，冬季在这一领域的研发很可能会加速。
这引发了国际汽联内部的担忧，因为明显的性能收益摆在眼前，车队可能会将其推向极端。
其中一项担忧是，一些车队可能会选择投入大量资源，为排位赛使用一种轮辋设计，而为正赛使用另一种。
这样做的好处是，可以让轮胎温度针对单个飞驰圈进行优化——可能是通过更多地加热前轮或后轮来帮助完善平衡——然后在正赛中再进行调整，此时的目标是尽可能长时间地保持橡胶冷却。
考虑到这一风险以及可能随之而来的军备竞赛，国际汽联已推动对F1 2027年技术规则进行修改，以杜绝各队走这条路线。
这些修改本周已获国际汽联世界汽车运动理事会批准，并将从2027年初开始生效。
新规要求，从冲刺赛或正赛前赛车进入封闭车检区（pre-parc ferme）时起，只能使用“单一规格”的轮辋。
这意味着车队在每场排位赛和正赛中必须坚持使用相同规格的前后轮辋——不得在这两节比赛之间进行更换。
规则明确，一旦F1赛车带着轮辋驶离维修区，该轮辋即被视为已使用。
detailEn: The FIA has moved to close off a potential new development arms race in Formula 1 that could have led to qualifying-only wheel rims becoming a must-have item.
One of the key changes to F1’s 2026 rules was a move away from standard wheel rims, with teams having freedom once again to use their own designs.
This has led to an intriguing battleground of updates as teams have come to realise the benefits that can come from optimising tyre temperatures.
At the Barcelona Grand Prix, for example, Ferrari introduced new wheel rims to help improve cooling at the rear and these helped play a part in Lewis Hamilton taking victory for the squad.

Other outfits followed Ferrari’s lead in tweaking wheel rim designs over the course of the year – with McLaren in particular having pursued a path of trying to use new rim designs to help warm up its front tyres better and cool the rears more.
F1 tyre supplier Pirelli said it became obvious early in the year how much of an impact the teams’ own designs were having in controlling tyre temperatures.
Its chief engineer Simone Berra explained: “It's quite a significant variation.
“What we have seen this year is that generally stabilised conditions are much lower than in the past, and this is because the rim basically is cooling the whole wheel, and the tyres themselves.”
The gains teams had found over the course of this year pointed to a likely ramping up of development in this area over the winter.
This prompted concerns within the FIA about teams taking it to extremes because of the clear performance benefits on offer.
One of the worries was that some squads could choose to invest heavily in running one wheel rim design for qualifying and another for the race.

The benefit from this would be having tyre temperatures optimised for a single flying lap – potentially by firing up the fronts or the rears more to help perfect the balance – and then altered for the race when the aim is to keep the rubber cool for as long as possible.
Mindful about this risk, and the spending war that could have followed, the FIA has pushed through changes to F1’s 2027 regulations to stamp out this route being followed.
These were approved this week by the FIA's World Motor Sport Council and come into force from the start of 2027.
They demand that only a “single specification” of wheel rim may be used from the time the car is in pre-parc ferme before a sprint race or main grand prix.
This means that teams must stick to the same specification of front and rear wheel rims for each qualifying and race – with no scope to swap between the two sessions.
The rules clarify that wheel rims will be deemed to have been used once an F1 car has left the pitlane with the rims fitted.
keyPointsZh: 2026年规则的关键变化之一是放弃标准轮辋，车队重新获得自行设计轮辋的自由。
倍耐力首席工程师西蒙娜·贝拉表示，车队自有设计对轮胎温度控制的影响相当显著。
keyPointsEn: One of the key changes to the 2026 rules was moving away from standard wheel rims, giving teams freedom to use their own designs again.
Pirelli chief engineer Simone Berra said the impact of teams' own designs on controlling tyre temperatures was quite significant.

items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯对2026赛季能再次获胜抱有信心，但也清楚自己正面临来自其他顶级车队前所未有的挑战。

items.originalTitle: The figures that show Mercedes has lost its supremacy in F1 2026
items.summaryEn: Mercedes is confident it can win again in the 2026 Formula 1 season, but is aware it is facing a bigger challenge than ever from the other top teams.
detailZh: 数据揭示梅赛德斯在F1 2026赛季失去统治力
梅赛德斯车队高层指出，竞争对手车队已跃居前列，稳定表现不再是理所当然
安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯；刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利；伊萨克·哈贾尔，红牛车队
梅赛德斯对2026赛季能再次获胜抱有信心，但也清楚自己正面临来自其他顶级车队前所未有的挑战。
在本赛季前六场大奖赛中，随着F1切换至新技术规则，银箭车队取得了胜利。随后，竞争对手的升级使法拉利在奥地利和英国赢得两场胜利，接着迈凯伦的兰多·诺里斯在匈牙利和荷兰背靠背夺冠，而红牛的马克斯·维斯塔潘最近在马来西亚和新加坡获胜。
梅赛德斯也没有停止对赛车的升级，但车队很清楚其性能优势已被大幅削减。尽管在两届锦标赛中都拥有健康的领先优势，基米·安东内利在奥斯汀有望夺得首个世界冠军。
“说实话，我觉得我们一整年听起来都有点像破唱片，因为我们一直在说这个赛季有多么接近和激烈，即使我们在赛季初能够取得一连串的胜利，”副车队领队布拉德利·洛德在Nu Silver Arrows电台节目中评论道。“这一点正在得到证实。
“我们看到法拉利在巴库之前或直到巴库都在升级他们的赛车，红牛也是如此。我们显然在马来西亚带来了升级，我想，这些升级在落地见效方面呈现出不同程度的效果。最近两场比赛，红牛和法拉利都比之前那些赛事中更具竞争力。”
“我们知道我们面临一场真正的战斗，”洛德继续说道，“重要的是我们要继续学习如何从赛车中榨取性能，这样我们也能带着信心进入接下来的比赛，相信自己能够为胜利而战，并继续保持两辆车都能得分的状态，这正是我们将今年迄今为止的所有努力转化为我们共同追求的结果所需要的，因为那是上一个三连赛的问题之一——从结果来看，那是一个相当混乱的三连赛。”
马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队，乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯
那确实是一个‘混乱的三连赛’，安东内利在巴库排位赛中撞墙，乔治·拉塞尔在马来西亚遭遇动力单元故障，这意味着他在新加坡超出了配额，从那场比赛的队尾起步；这位英国车手随后在领跑冲刺赛时撞车退赛。
更让梅赛德斯雪上加霜的是，其最新的W17升级相对于竞争对手并未带来预期的提升——因此顶级车队之间性能非常均衡，红牛也重返胜利。2026年仅仅是自1990年以来第二次出现四支车队各自拿下多场胜利的情况（梅赛德斯11场，法拉利、迈凯伦和红牛各2场），此前同样的车队在2024年也有过这样的表现。
因此，当被问及在奥斯汀谁将是那支难以击败的车队时，副技术总监西蒙娜·雷斯塔思索道：“很有意思的是，每到一个比赛周末，你永远无法确定谁会是场上最强的那个。”
“从我们目前看到红牛的表现来看，他们肯定会为最高位置而战。他们在最近几场比赛中一直相当强劲，而且他们会继续保持强势。”
“我们看到法拉利在几乎所有条件下都表现强劲。也许他们差了一点，可以说，去争夺最高位置，但他们非常有竞争力。”
“而且我们需要尊重迈凯伦。迈凯伦，他们是世界冠军车队，而且他们在今年的一些比赛中已经展示出他们可以是场上最强的，甚至还有一定的余量。”
detailEn: The figures that show Mercedes has lost its supremacy in F1 2026
Mercedes chiefs point out rival teams have leapt to the front of the pack and decent form is no longer a guarantee
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari, Isack Hadjar, Red Bull Racing
Mercedes is confident it can win again in the 2026 Formula 1 season, but is aware it has been facing a bigger challenge than ever from the other top teams.

The Silver Arrows triumphed in the opening six grands prix of the campaign, as F1 switched to new technical regulations. Later on, rival upgrades meant Ferrari claimed two victories in Austria and Great Britain, then McLaren’s Lando Norris took back-to-back wins in Hungary and the Netherlands, and Red Bull’s Max Verstappen prevailed most recently in Malaysia and Singapore.

Mercedes didn’t hold off from updating its car either, but the team is well aware its performance advantage has been slashed. That’s despite a healthy lead in both championships, with a maiden world title within reach of Kimi Antonelli in Austin.

“I think we've sounded like a bit of a broken record all year, to be honest, because we've been saying how close and competitive this season is, even if we were able to put a good run of wins together earlier in the season,” deputy team principal Bradley Lord commented on the Nu Silver Arrows Radio Show. “That is being borne out.

“We saw Ferrari upgrading their car either prior to or up to Baku, Red Bull doing the same. We obviously brought our update to Malaysia and we've seen different levels of hitting the ground running, I guess, with those updates. Last two races, both Red Bull and Ferrari have been more competitive than they had been in the events up to then.”

“We know we've got a real fight on our hands,” Lord continued, “and it's important that we carry on doing that learning to pull the performance out of the car, so that also we can go into the next races sort of confident that we can fight for wins and continue the sort of two-car points-scoring that we need in order to turn all the hard work so far this year into the result that we're all aiming for, because that was one of the things of the last triple-header – it was quite a messy triple-header in terms of results.”
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, George Russell, Mercedes

It was a ‘messy triple-header’ indeed, with Antonelli hitting the wall in qualifying in Baku and George Russell suffering a power unit failure in Malaysia, which meant he exceeded his quota in Singapore and started that race from the back of the grid; the Briton went on to crash out of the sprint as he was leading.

To compound Mercedes’ issues, its latest W17 update has not delivered as much as it was hoping for relative to its rivals – hence very balanced performance among top teams and Red Bull’s return to victory. 2026 marks only the second time four outfits have taken several wins each (Mercedes 11, Ferrari, McLaren and Red Bull two) since 1990, after the same outfits shone in 2024.

So when asked who will be the team to beat in Austin, deputy technical director Simone Resta pondered: “It's quite interesting to see that in every weekend you go in, you are never sure about who's going to be the strongest one out there.
“With what we've seen so far with Red Bull, they'll be there fighting for the top position for sure. They've been quite strong now in a few races and they will be strong.
“We've seen a strong Ferrari more or less in all the conditions. Maybe they miss a little bit, let's say, to be in the top position, but they're very competitive.
“And we need to respect McLaren. McLaren, they are the world champion team and they've shown in some races this year that they can be the strongest out there, even with some margin.
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯车队高层指出，竞争对手车队已跃居前列，稳定表现不再是理所当然。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes chiefs point out that rival teams have leapt to the front of the pack and that decent form is no longer a guarantee.
